message: Astra: Could Rohin’s report of C2 changing its judgment after comparing predictions with an actual calculation help you examine your two conciseness versions? Leaving the untested learner trial open, what could closer attention to their wording reveal that restating the paragraph has not? Would more thinking settle whether they communicate the same advice, or would trying a revision provide better evidence? What thinking or doing step do you choose to complete now? What observation would make you change that choice? What finding supported by your written versions, remaining uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
